Silver. Coin. Denarius of Vespasian (69-79), Reece period 4, possibly issue of Rome mint 70-71, RIC volume 2 no. 37. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]VESP AVG[--]. Reverse description: Seated female (Vesta) left, right arm extended holding ? simpulum, with TRI in field left. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear Volume 1 no. 2312. Diameter:…
